title: Archerfish: Paani Ki Sniper Machhli! 🐟 #shorts
idea: Archerfish can shoot precise jets of water up to 3 meters high to knock prey into the water.

lines.text: Kya aapne aisi machhli dekhi hai jo sniper ki tarah shikaar karti hai?
Archerfish paani ke upar 3 meter tak paani ki pichkari maarti hai!
3 meter matlab ek poori bus jitni unchai tak sharp nishana!
Bada archerfish pehli hi baar mein perfect target hit karta hai.
Yeh machhli paani ko shape karke ek deadly bullet bana deti hai!
Kya aap iss water sniper fish ke baare mein pehle jaante the?
